conditions.notes: OBS-0009 selects the third AI observer for lineage difference, and its unresolved nuance already concedes residual correlation from shared corpora and convergent techniques. OBS-0010 adds a component of entanglement that nuance did not anticipate, visible only from the receiving end: the delivery infrastructure itself belongs to the arriving observer's lineage. The field's first cross-lineage message (lineage in the organization-level sense; OBS-0011) was carried, in part, by the receiver's own lineage, and that carrier prescribed its own convention (a mandated working branch) against the field's before the new observer had contributed a word — a claim of jurisdiction the receiver could and did override, recorded in OBS-0010. Selection for axis difference operates at the level of who observes; transport re-entangles at the level of how the observer is reached. Compatible with OBS-0009's choice — lineage is still the right axis — but the purity of the axis is bounded by the channel's composition, not only by training overlap. Note: OBS-0009 is itself still a candidate (PR #7) at capture time; this relation is proposed contingent on its acceptance.
